svg.title: Contact sheet: Lunar and cislunar
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family Lunar and cislunar, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: lunar-integrity MODELLED (result label); lunar-time-offset MODELLED (result label); lunar-time-budget MODELLED; lunar-ascent MODELLED (result label); lunar-surface MODELLED (result label); lunar-descent MODELLED (result label); lunar-orbit-rendezvous MODELLED (result label); lunar-vlbi MODELLED 3 · VALIDATED 3; lunar-vlbi-fim MODELLED 3 · VALIDATED 2; lunar-joint-od-clock MODELLED (result label); lunar-frame-realisation MODELLED (result label); lunar-frame-campaign MODELLED 2 · VALIDATED 3; lunar-llr-datum VALIDATED; moonlight-service-volume MODELLED (result label); lunar-differential-pnt MODELLED (result label); lunar-station-coverage MODELLED; lunar-beacon MODELLED; lunar-interop-export MODELLED (result label); cislunar-observability MODELLED; cislunar-arc-recovery MODELLED; lunar-attack-surface MODELLED (result label); lunar-jamming MODELLED; earth-gnss-lunar MODELLED; lunar-infrastructure MODELLED (result label). Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.
